about: CAMERA.md (camera rules) + SHOT-DIRECTION.md §3 (continuity) as the machine-checkable subset the chapter line enforces on the shot-motion contract (tasks/session-<chapter>.motion.json). A contract that disagrees fails the chapter check before it renders. The rules that need the measured picture (180°/30°, screen direction, reading speed, reference camera path replay) stay with the chapter measurement and the reviews — listed under notMachineChecked.

vocabulary.static: locked — the default; the camera stays put
vocabulary.push: slow push (2–4 % over 3 s or longer)
vocabulary.cut: a cut inside the shot, only where the reference cuts at that moment
vocabulary.whip: seam-only whip (whip out/in at a cut, never a whole shot)

notMachineChecked: 30° rule between two appearances of the same subject
reading speed (measured on the animatic: camera px per frame while type is read)
the reference's own camera path (OptFlowCam / Blender bake replay — not wired into chapters yet)
